## Background

Defines what "complex tasks" means for this thesis: the concrete task
suite OARbot must perform (long-horizon, multi-step, language-
conditioned), per-task success criteria, and the metrics reported in
the final evaluation — success rate, generalization to unseen object /
scene / instruction variations, and data efficiency. Informed by the
benchmarks found in [A1](../A1-literature-review/README.qmd); consumed
by dataset collection (B2) and the final evaluation (C3).
